newsitem.title: USA: Oldendorp joins GMS Group muni institutional sales.
newsitem.headline: Oldendorp joins GMS Group muni institutional sales.

text.p: Neal Oldendorp, formerly of Samuel A. Ramirez & Co, is scheduled to start Wednesday as the newest member of New Jersey-based GMS Group's rapidly growing institutional municipal sales force.
Oldendorp's hire brings the total number of professionals in the group to 12, according to Lou D'Andrea, the senior vice president who runs it. More hires are on the way, he said.
"We have three more people that we believe will be joining us in the near future," D'Andrea said.
When D'Andrea came on board from JB Hanauer & Co April, GMS had three institutional salesmen in place, excluding him. Five other JB Hanauer professionals have joined GMS since D'Andrea's departure.

They are: Philip Dillon, Joel Shilling, E. Michael Shine, Gary Milotta and Todd Rogers. In addition, Bill Schroeder, formerly of Reinoso & Co and John Ceresa, formerly of Prudential Securities Inc, have joined the firm.
GMS Group is based in Livingston, N.J..
